headline: Set Geno Smith as Joe Burrow's AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff — Burrow (back, Questionable) was a full practice participant Friday and plans to start.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and his current lineup is already the best one available: no free agent this week clearly beats his bench, and the Geno Smith/Kyle Pitts trade fixed his QB byes (Burrow wk6, C. Williams wk10, Smith wk13), so no waiver moves are worth making today. The only live risk is Burrow's back soreness — full practice Friday, Sep 18 and expected to start — but the Geno Smith AutoSub (same 10:00 AM kickoff) is free insurance and still isn't set. A.J. Brown stays on IR (high ankle sprain) with no eligible IR moves available.

subs.why: Burrow is Questionable (back soreness) but was a full practice participant Fri, Sep 18 and is expected to start; Geno Smith kicks off at the same time (Sun 10:00 AM PT vs GB), so set the pair before then for free cover.

watch.what: Committee with Chris Brooks and Kaleb Johnson while Josh Jacobs sits on the exempt list (since Sep 2); his volume (11.5 carries/2.5 targets) still trails Aaron Jones — recheck if his touches climb before swapping him in for Jones

alerts.title: 🔁 Set Geno as Burrow's AutoSub
alerts.body: Burrow (Questionable, back) plans to start, but pair Geno Smith as his AutoSub before Sunday 10:00 AM PT kickoff — free insurance since both games start at the same time.
